import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sleep_disorder_order = df['Sleep Disorder'].value_counts().index.tolist()
for i, disorder in enumerate(sleep_disorder_order):
    if pd.isna(disorder):
        subset = df[df['Sleep Disorder'].isna()]
        label = 'None'
    else:
        subset = df[df['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder]
        label = disorder
    ax1.scatter(subset['Sleep Duration'], subset['Quality of Sleep'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=80, label=label, color=colors[i])
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', loc='best')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. BMI Category distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
colors_bmi = ['#ff6b6b', '#f9ca24', '#6ab04c']
ax2.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
        colors=colors_bmi, startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Stress Level by Occupation
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :])
occupation_stress = df.groupby('Occupation')['Stress Level'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = ax3.barh(occupation_stress.index, occupation_stress.values, 
                color=sns.color_palette("Reds_r", len(occupation_stress)))
ax3.set_xlabel('Average Stress Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Average Stress Level by Occupation', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='x')
# Add value labels
for i, (idx, val) in enumerate(occupation_stress.items()):
    ax3.text(val + 0.05, i, f'{val:.1f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 4. Physical Activity Level vs Heart Rate
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
ax4.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Heart Rate'], 
           alpha=0.5, c=df['Age'], cmap='viridis', s=60)
ax4.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Physical Activity vs Heart Rate', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(ax4.collections[0], ax=ax4)
cbar.set_label('Age', fontsize=10)
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 5. Daily Steps by Gender
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['Gender'])
gender_steps = [df_clean[df_clean['Gender'] == g]['Daily Steps'].values for g in df_clean['Gender'].unique()]
bp = ax5.boxplot(gender_steps, labels=df_clean['Gender'].unique(), patch_artist=True,
                 boxprops=dict(facecolor='lightblue', alpha=0.7),
                 medianprops=dict(color='red', linewidth=2))
ax5.set_xlabel('Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Daily Steps Distribution by Gender', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 6. Sleep Duration by Age Group
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
df['Age Group'] = pd.cut(df['Age'], bins=[0, 30, 40, 50, 100], 
                         labels=['<30', '30-40', '40-50', '50+'])
age_sleep = df.groupby('Age Group')['Sleep Duration'].mean()
bars = ax6.bar(range(len(age_sleep)), age_sleep.values, 
               color=sns.color_palette("Blues", len(age_sleep)))
ax6.set_xticks(range(len(age_sleep)))
ax6.set_xticklabels(age_sleep.index, rotation=0)
ax6.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Average Sleep Duration (hrs)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Sleep Duration by Age Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')
# Add value labels
for i, val in enumerate(age_sleep.values):
    ax6.text(i, val + 0.05, f'{val:.1f}', ha='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

plt.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
